title: Hieratic ostracon with one column of accounts, Met 26.3.166

object.name: Hieratic ostracon with one column of accounts (Met 26.3.166)
object.holder: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York

source.attribution: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Rogers Fund, 1926

notes: Met accession 26.3.166; Met objectName: "Ostracon, hieratic". Provenance per Met: Egypt, Upper Egypt, Thebes, Deir el-Bahri, Tomb of Nespekashuty (TT 312, MMA 509); MMA excavations, 1922–23. Cropped to the inscribed upper part of the ostracon. Caveat: the Met record (title says hieratic) is also returned by a Met API phrase search for "cursive hieroglyphs", so its description, which could not be retrieved (website blocks scripted access), mentions cursive hieroglyphs somewhere; this ostracon belongs to the 26.3.165-171 group, one of which (26.3.169) is titled as mixing hieratic with names in hieroglyphs. Worth an expert glance. Image 1577x2000 px, from the Met original file.
